scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Sorry but you can't get married right now.
The wedding is only available for subscribed players.
But if you have a ^FF0000Marriage Covenant^000000, then you'll be able to get married!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
抱歉，你现在还不能结婚。
婚礼服务只对订阅玩家开放。
不过，只要有^FF0000结婚契约^000000，就可以结婚！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Hello~
My name is Marry Happy
and I'm here to provide you
with information related to
marriage. Now, did you
have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
你好~
我是玛丽·哈皮，负责为你介绍结婚相关事宜。
有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text: I want to get married.
scripts.translation: 我想结婚

scripts.text: I don't need your help!
scripts.translation: 我不需要你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Oh, I'm sorry, but
adopted characters
aren't allowed to get
married. For now, why
don't you enjoy the simple
pleasures of childhood?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
哎呀，抱歉，被收养的角色不能结婚。
现在还是先享受无忧无虑的童年吧？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Oh, of course you
don't! Little children
can't get married-- there
are too many laws against
that~ Aren't you the most
adorable little thing?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
哦，你当然不需要啦！
小孩子不能结婚，法律可不允许哦~
你真是个可爱的小宝贝！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Marriage is the beautiful
union of two souls that have
chosen to be together forever,
to share their joy and lives.
Is there a special someone
like that in your life?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
婚姻是两个灵魂美好的结合，选择永远相伴，分享喜悦和人生。
你的生命中，有这样特别的人吗？

scripts.text: Ask about Wedding Ceremony
scripts.translation: 询问婚礼仪式

scripts.text: Ask about Procedure
scripts.translation: 询问流程

scripts.text: Apply for Wedding
scripts.translation: 申请结婚

scripts.text: We are the Invincible Single Army!
scripts.translation: 我们是无敌的单身军团！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Wise and benevolent
King Tristram III used to
conduct wedding ceremonies,
but he's no longer able to do
so because of his royal duties
and freneticly paced schedule.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
睿智仁慈的特里斯拉姆三世国王过去曾亲自主持婚礼。
不过，王室事务繁忙，日程又紧，他已经无法继续主持了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Bishop Vomars, the bishop
of love, is now the officiator
of the marriage ceremony.
He is truly a treasure to the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
如今由爱之主教沃马斯主持婚礼。
他真是卢恩·米德加兹王国的瑰宝。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
When you marry someone,
it's for the rest of your life, so think carefully before making or
accepting a marriage proposal.
Keep in mind that a man can only
marry a woman and vice versa.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
结婚是要共度一生，所以提出或接受求婚前，请认真考虑。
另外，男性只能与女性结婚，女性也只能与男性结婚。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
If you're lucky enough to
find someone that you really
want to spend the rest of your
life with, you might want to pop the question. I hope everyone
finds their perfect match~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
若有幸找到真正想共度余生的人，不妨向对方求婚。
希望大家都能找到理想的伴侣~

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
The first part of the
wedding procedure is to
complete the application.
Once the bride and bridegroom
have finished applying, they
must form a party of two.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
婚礼流程的第一步是完成申请。
新郎和新娘都申请完毕后，必须组成一支两人队伍。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
After forming a party of two,
the couple must then speak to
Bishop Vomars. The bridegroom
speaks first and must tell his
bride's exact name to the Bishop. Otherwise, the ceremony will stop.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
组好两人队伍后，就去找沃马斯主教。
新郎先与主教交谈，必须准确报出新娘的名字，否则仪式就会中止。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Afterwards, the bride will
speak to the Bishop and tell
him the name of her groom.
If these names are correctly
told to the Bishop, they will
be able to exchange rings.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
接着，新娘与主教交谈，报出新郎的名字。
双方报出的名字都正确，就可以交换戒指了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Once the wedding rings are
exchanged, the couple is forever bound in matrimony. Of course,
before this point, there are many chances to change your mind, so...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
交换结婚戒指后，两人就永远结为夫妻。
当然，在那之前，还有很多机会改变主意，所以...

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
If there are too many
couples who want to get
married at one time, please
form a line and speak to Bishop
Vomars in order since only one couple can be married at a time.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
如果同时有很多对新人想结婚，请排队，依次与沃马斯主教交谈。
一次只能为一对新人举行婚礼。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Finally, be sure to tell
Bishop Vomars your partner's
exact name without wasting too much time. If you take too long,
the ceremony will automatically stop and you'll have to try again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
最后，记得及时向沃马斯主教准确报出伴侣的名字。
拖得太久，仪式会自动中止，只能重新来过。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Brides need to remember
that they only have 3 minutes
to finish speaking to Bishop
Vomars after their grooms
have finished speaking to him.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
新娘要记住，新郎与沃马斯主教交谈完毕后，你只有3分钟来完成与主教的对话。

scripts.text: Thanks, that helps a lot!
scripts.translation: 谢谢，帮大忙了

scripts.text: Easiest way to say my partner's name?
scripts.translation: 怎样快速输入伴侣的名字

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Well, I'm here to help
weddings proceed as
smoothly as possible.
If there was something
you didn't understand,
feel free to ask me again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
我的工作就是尽量让婚礼顺利进行。
有什么不明白的，随时再来问我。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
The easiest way to write
your partner's name for the
bishop is to send a private
message to your partner, and
then left-click the name section that is left of the chat prompt.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
向主教输入伴侣名字最简单的方法，是先给伴侣发一条私聊消息，再用鼠标左键点击聊天输入框左侧的名字栏。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Press the ''Ctrl'' and ''C''
keys to copy the name. Then,
you can paste the name into
the input prompt by pressing
the ''Insert'' and ''Shift'' keys. That sounds easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
按Ctrl + C复制名字，再按Shift + Insert粘贴到输入框。
很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Alright, now let's try
it. Practice giving me the
name of your partner using
the method I just described.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
好，现在来试试。
按照刚才的方法，练习把伴侣的名字输入给我。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Alright, after you've
decided to get married,
come back to me and
submit your application.
I'll see you later, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
决定结婚后，再来找我提交申请。
回头见，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
^FF0000Wait!^000000
^FF0000If your account in not a premium, you must have a Marriage Covenant to get married.^000000
^FF0000Please check the current state of your account, and the one of your lover, before register for a wedding.^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
^FF0000等等！^000000
^FF0000如果你的账号不是高级账号，就必须持有结婚契约才能结婚。^000000
^FF0000登记婚礼前，请确认你和爱人的账号状态。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a groom, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Tuxedo^000000 and give me your ^3377FF1 Marriage Covenant^000000.
Brides have to provide their own Wedding Dresses and pay a fee
of 1,200,000 zeny or also bring a Marriage Covenant.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
想结婚吗？
新郎需要准备^3377FF1套燕尾服^000000，并交给我^3377FF1份结婚契约^000000。
新娘需要自备结婚礼服，支付1,200,000 Zeny，或同样携带一份结婚契约。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a groom, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Tuxedo^000000 and pay ^3377FF1,300,000 zeny^000000.
Brides have to provide their own Wedding Dresses and pay a fee
of 1,200,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
想结婚吗？
新郎需要准备^3377FF1套燕尾服^000000，并支付^3377FF1,300,000 Zeny^000000。
新娘需要自备结婚礼服，并支付1,200,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a bride, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Wedding Dress^000000 and give me your ^3377FFMarriage Covenant^000000.
Grooms must bring a Tuxedo and pay
1,300,000 zeny or also bring a Marriage Covenant.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
想结婚吗？
新娘需要准备^3377FF1件结婚礼服^000000，并交给我^3377FF结婚契约^000000。
新郎需要携带燕尾服，支付1,300,000 Zeny，或同样携带一份结婚契约。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
So you'd like to get married?
As a bride, you need to prepare
^3377FF1 Wedding Dress^000000 and pay a fee of 1,200,000 zeny. Grooms must
bring a Tuxedo and pay 1,300,000 zeny to get married.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
想结婚吗？
新娘需要准备^3377FF1件结婚礼服^000000，并支付1,200,000 Zeny。
新郎需要携带燕尾服，并支付1,300,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Brides and grooms also need
to have ^3377FF1 Diamond Ring^000000 to be
exchanged with their partners.
You'll need all of these items
prepared when you submit your
wedding ceremony application.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
新郎和新娘还必须各自准备^3377FF1枚钻石戒指^000000，与伴侣交换。
提交婚礼申请时，所有这些物品都要准备好。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
The prospective bride and
groom must both complete
application process before
the wedding can take place.
Now, would you like to
apply for marriage?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
准新郎和准新娘都必须完成申请，才能举行婚礼。
现在要申请结婚吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
I'm sorry, but you can't
apply for another marriage!
I can't allow you to betray
your spouse like that, and
besides, polygamy isn't
legal here in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
抱歉，你不能再申请结婚！
我可不能让你这样背叛配偶，而且卢恩·米德加兹也不允许重婚。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Didn't you already
complete the application?
Hmm, make sure that your
partner also finished the
application process, and
then talk to Bishop Vomars.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
你不是已经申请完了吗？
确认伴侣也完成申请后，就去找沃马斯主教吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Hmm, you need to be
strong enough to protect
the one that you love before
you can consider marriage.
After you grow stronger,
come and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
嗯，考虑结婚之前，要先有足够的力量保护心爱的人。
等你变强了，再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Mm? Did you forget to
bring the Diamond Ring
to exchange with your partner
during the wedding ceremony?
Look for it carefully and come
back after you find it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
嗯？是不是忘了带婚礼上与伴侣交换的钻石戒指？
仔细找找，找到了再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
I'm sorry, but all brides
must pay the 1,200,000
zeny fee or bring a Marriage
Covenant to proceed with the
wedding ceremony. Perhaps
you could ask your partner
to help you with the funds?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
抱歉，新娘必须支付1,200,000 Zeny，或携带结婚契约，才能举行婚礼。
要不要请伴侣帮你凑些钱？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Oh dear, did you forget
your Wedding Dress?
Hurry and find it, then
bring it to me-- you
absolutely need it
for the wedding!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
哎呀，是不是忘了带结婚礼服？
快去找来交给我，婚礼上可少不了它！

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have the 1,300,000 zeny
or the Marriage Covenant
that all grooms must pay
for the wedding ceremony.
Did you misplace your money?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
抱歉，你没有1,300,000 Zeny，也没有结婚契约。
新郎必须提供其中一种，才能举行婚礼。
你是不是把钱放错地方了？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Where's your Tuxedo?
You absolutely have to
wear it during the wedding
ceremony! Find it, bring it
to me, and then we can finally
begin the wedding, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
你的燕尾服呢？
婚礼上必须穿燕尾服！
找来交给我，我们就能开始婚礼了，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Well, it looks like you
have everything ready.
Although I'm not sure who
your partner is, let me be
the first to congratulate you
on your upcoming wedding~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
看来你都准备好了。
虽然还不知道你的伴侣是谁，就让我先祝贺你们即将举行的婚礼吧~

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Now, let's begin the
application. Please write
down your exact name here.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
现在开始申请吧。
请在这里准确输入自己的名字。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Hmmm, you have to write
down your name exactly as
it is displayed. Maybe you
need to copy and paste it?
Anyway, let's try it again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
Hmmm，名字必须和显示的完全一致。
要不要试试复制粘贴？
我们再来一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Great, it looks like we
finished your application.
Remember that you'll need
to tell Bishop Vomars your
partner's exact name when
you talk to him later, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
好，你的申请完成了。
记住，稍后与沃马斯主教交谈时，要准确报出伴侣的名字，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
When your partner is
finished with the application
process, both of you should
speak to the Bishop to begin
the wedding ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
伴侣也完成申请后，你们就一起去找主教，开始婚礼仪式。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Since you're the bride,
you need to wait for the
groom to speak to Bishop
Vomars first. When he's
finished, it'll be your turn
to speak to Bishop Vomars.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
你是新娘，要等新郎先与沃马斯主教交谈。
他完成后，才轮到你。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
Since you're the groom,
you need to speak to the
Bishop first. When you're
finished, it will be your
bride's turn to speak to
Bishop Vomars.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
你是新郎，要先与主教交谈。
你完成后，就轮到新娘与沃马斯主教交谈。

scripts.text:
[Marry Happy]
No...?
Well, when you're
ready for marriage,
feel free to come back to
me so that you can apply,
okay? Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·哈皮]
不...？
好吧，准备好结婚了，随时来找我申请。
祝你愉快~

scripts.text:
[Single Army]
^CC9933You have to refine
items on your own to
make great equipment!^000000
scripts.translation:
[单身军团]
^CC9933好装备要靠自己精炼出来！^000000

scripts.text:
[Single Army]
^330099It's a waste to
form parties in
dungeons! I can
make it on my own!^000000
scripts.translation:
[单身军团]
^330099组队探索地下城纯属浪费！
我一个人就能搞定！^000000

scripts.text:
[Single Army]
^666666Hell, I've trained
all by myself since
birth, all the way
to my job change!^000000
scripts.translation:
[单身军团]
^666666哼，我从出生到转职，一直都是自己练的！^000000

scripts.text:
[Single Army]
^666600I CHOOSE to spend
Christmas alone...
playing Solitaire and
doing crossword puzzles!^000000
scripts.translation:
[单身军团]
^666600我就是要一个人过圣诞节...玩纸牌接龙，做填字游戏！^000000

scripts.text:
[Single Army]
^CC9966Women may break my
spirit, but they'll never
take... my FREEDOM!^000000
scripts.translation:
[单身军团]
^CC9966女人或许能摧毁我的意志，但永远夺不走...我的自由！^000000

scripts.text:
[Single Army]
^669900...We're the free! We're
the Invincible Single Army!^000000
scripts.translation:
[单身军团]
^669900...我们是自由的！
我们是无敌的单身军团！^000000

 spirit, but they'll never

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Greetings, child.
Are you lost? Hmmm.
Do you know where your
mommy and daddy are?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
你好，孩子。
迷路了吗？Hmmm.
你知道爸爸妈妈在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Young lovers, please
remember this moment for
the rest of your lives. May your future be blessed with peace
and joy. May the love you share
grow with each passing day.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
年轻的恋人们，请一生铭记这一刻。
愿你们的未来平安喜乐，愿彼此的爱与日俱增。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Until the end of the
world, may you stand
by the side of the one
whom you love, to support
her and protect her. Now, may
I know the name of your bride?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
愿你始终陪伴在爱人身边，支持她、保护她，直到世界的尽头。
现在，请告诉我新娘的名字。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Mr. {0}...
Do you swear on your life
that you will forever cherish
and care for your bride,
Miss {1}?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
{0}先生...
你愿意以生命起誓，永远珍爱并照顾你的新娘{1}小姐吗？

scripts.text: I do.
scripts.translation: 我愿意

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Now, it is time for
your bride to make
her wedding vows.
If she will come forward...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
现在，轮到新娘许下婚姻誓言了。
请她上前...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I'm sorry, but the groom
must speak to me first in
order to begin the wedding.
It's old fashioned protocol,
but I'll admit that it does
keep things running smoothly.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
抱歉，必须由新郎先与我交谈，才能开始婚礼。
虽然是旧规矩，不过确实能让仪式顺利进行。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Before you can be
married, you must
first form a party of
two with your partner.
Then, we can proceed
with the ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
结婚前，请先和伴侣组成一支两人队伍。
这样才能继续举行仪式。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
You must apply for
marriage with Happy Marry
before you can get married.
Happy Marry will let you know
what else you'll need to do
to prepare for marriage.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
结婚前，必须先向玛丽·哈皮提交申请。
她会告诉你还需要为婚礼做哪些准备。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Young lovers, please
remember this moment for
the rest of your lives. May your future be blessed with peace
and joy. May the love you share
grow with each passing day.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
年轻的恋人们，请一生铭记这一刻。
愿你们的未来平安喜乐，愿彼此的爱与日俱增。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Miss {0}...
Do you swear to stay
true to {1},
to be by his side, no matter
what the dangers may be?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
{0}小姐...
你愿意起誓忠于{1}，无论遇到什么危险，都陪伴在他身边吗？

scripts.text: I do.
scripts.translation: 我愿意

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
So {0}
isn't the one you
want to marry? Hmm.
I'm truly sorry for this
misunderstanding...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
所以，{0}不是你想嫁的人吗？
嗯，对这场误会，我深感抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Do you truly swear
fidelity and patience?
Will you marry {0}?
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
你真心愿意起誓，始终忠诚、耐心相待吗？
你愿意嫁给{0}吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
By the power invested
in me as Royal Bishop of
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
I now pronounce you husband
and wife. May your future be
blessed with many great joys.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
以我作为卢恩·米德加兹王国皇家主教所获授的权力，现在宣布你们结为夫妻。
愿你们的未来充满喜乐。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
And lastly...
Always be happy,
dear {0}...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
最后...
亲爱的{0}，愿你永远幸福...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Hm. It seems that
your groom left before
the ceremony has finished
Please try again once he's
returned.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
嗯，看来新郎在仪式结束前离开了。
等他回来后，再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Hm. It seems that
you've changed your
mind. Although I feel
sorry for the groom, you
must do what your heart
tells you is right. Now, run!
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
嗯，看来你改变主意了。
虽然我为新郎感到遗憾，不过你应该遵从自己的心。
现在，快跑吧！

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Hm? It appears that
Happy Marry still hasn't
received your marriage
application. Please speak
to her so that we can begin
the wedding ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
嗯？看来玛丽·哈皮还没收到你的结婚申请。
请先去找她，我们才能开始婚礼仪式。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I wish you eternal
happiness. No matter
how dark the present may
be, always stand by your
loved one's side and look
to the future with hope.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
愿你们永远幸福。
无论眼前多么黑暗，都请陪伴在爱人身边，满怀希望地迎向未来。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
The wedding of
Miss {0} and
Mister {1}
is currently in progress.
Please keep your voice down.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
{0}小姐和{1}先生的婚礼正在进行中。
请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
I'm conducting a wedding
for another couple now, so
please wait patiently for your
turn. Thanks for understanding...
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
我正在为另一对新人主持婚礼，请耐心等候。
谢谢理解...

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
Wh-who are you?
You must know the
password to invoke
my awesome powers.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
你...你是谁？
只有知道密码，才能唤起我的强大力量。

scripts.text:
[Vomars]
This is
no place for
fooling around.
scripts.translation:
[沃马斯]
这里可不是胡闹的地方。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Switch]
Is there a problem with
the wedding ceremony?
I can reset the Bishop
Vomars NPC if you like.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼开关]
婚礼仪式出问题了吗？
需要的话，我可以重置沃马斯主教NPC。

scripts.text: No, thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: RESET
scripts.translation: 重置

scripts.text:
[Wedding Switch]
Alright, then.
However, if the
Bishop Vomars
NPC is stuck, it may
be best to reset it.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼开关]
好吧。
不过，如果沃马斯主教NPC卡住了，最好还是重置一下。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Switch]
The Bishop Vomars NPC
has now been reactivated.
It should now be possible
to proceed with weddings.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼开关]
沃马斯主教NPC已重新启用。
现在应该可以继续举行婚礼了。

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
Uh oh...
You know I can't
do anything for you.
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
Uh oh...
你知道，我帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
Hmm...
You really
shouldn't be
in this place...
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
Hmm...
你真的不该来这里...

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
Great, you know the
password! Now, did you
want me to remove the
Wedding Ring in your
inventory?
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
很好，你知道密码！
要我移除你物品栏中的结婚戒指吗？

scripts.text: Drop 1 Wedding Ring.
scripts.translation: 丢弃1枚结婚戒指

scripts.text: Keep it.
scripts.translation: 保留

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
It's done!
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
完成了！

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
I couldn't find
the Wedding Ring...
Please make sure
that it's not equipped.
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
我没找到结婚戒指...
请确认它没有装备在身上。

scripts.text:
[Bad Ending]
You sure you want
to keep that ring?
Alright, but if it becomes
a problem, you come to me.
scripts.translation:
[坏结局]
确定要保留那枚戒指吗？
好吧，要是它带来麻烦，就来找我。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Hmm...?
What exactly are
you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
Hmm...?
你来这里到底想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Ahk!
An adventurer
like you shouldn't
be in this place!
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
Ahk!
像你这样的冒险者不该来这里！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Hmm...
I can only create
a Wedding Ring if the
character is married.
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
Hmm...
只有已婚角色，我才能为其制作结婚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Ah, I see that you
know the password.
Alright, if you somehow
lost your Wedding Ring,
I can make you a new one.
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
啊，看来你知道密码。
如果你弄丢了结婚戒指，我可以给你做一枚新的。

scripts.text: Make new Wedding Ring.
scripts.translation: 制作新的结婚戒指

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Wait, wait...
You're wearing your
Wedding Ring. I better
not make you another since
you don't need more than one.
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
等等，等等...
你已经戴着结婚戒指了。
既然一枚就够了，我还是不给你再做一枚了。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Here you go~
It's your brand
new Wedding Ring!
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
给你~
这是你崭新的结婚戒指！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Again]
Alright. If you ever
lose your Wedding Ring,
come to me if you happen
to need a new one, okay?
scripts.translation:
[再婚]
好吧。
以后如果弄丢了结婚戒指，需要补一枚，就来找我。
